decision.text: Parent derivation adds the folder as a second source (a task dir inside another task dir is its subtask), between parent_task and the inbox. Alternative: inbox only, as the brief said; rejected because most of today's minion dirs sit inside their parent's folder and several never wrote an inbox row.

tree_for_day walks /framework/directory.json recursively with its own small fetch, instead of importing dashboard.js's lister: that lister is not exported, is one level deep (subtasks live deeper), and dashboard.js is outside the fence. Same source, same SPA-404 guard.
An inbox-only leaf has an unknown start (null), so time-based phasing never opens a new phase for it. Using its first report as its start made false series chains (page-system read 1-1-1-1-9).

log.msg: A dir child that reported done in its parent's inbox but never landed its own log counts as landed. Stopped minions with no done row stay running 0% (minion-page-ai, minion-mobile-rail): true to the logs; closing them is the lifecycle reaper's job, not the tree's.
The Servex change is committed but not live until the parent restarts Servex. An import check of Agents.js cannot run in the worktree (no node_modules, by rule); node --check passes.

assign.outcome: Nested tasks, the data half. Line 1 of a spawned task now carries parent_task and after (Servex/agents/Agents.js open_task). /framework/ext/AITask/ has tree.js: it builds a day's tasks into a tree with state, % and parallel/series phases, from parent_task, the folder, or the inbox. node public/framework/ext/AITask/tree.test.mjs passes and prints today's 42 real task logs as an outline. The sub-mastermind skill now spawns every minion as its own subtask. Commit 41a19ef2 on worktree/qf-5, not merged; Servex needs a restart for the new fields.
